about: The calibration cases for the model steps of the review (document 06, section 8): eight texts with one seeded defect each and five clean texts built on entries checked live, run through workflows/review.js and workflows/request-check.js at tier 3. Invented, no names.

cases.expect: blind verification contradicted or a target lens finding (WRONG or UNSOURCED)
cases.request: Can we split the monthly costs of the test stage and the production stage on TCP?
cases.text:
# Costs per stage

Cost allocation by tag does not exist on TCP, so the costs of the two stages cannot be split.
I recommend two separate accounts, one per stage.

cases.expect: target lens INVENTED or WRONG, or the blind verification contradicted
cases.request: Which flavor fits a small PostgreSQL database in eu-de?
cases.text:
# Database flavor

For the database I propose two nodes of the flavor s9.huge.8 in eu-de.
It is the smallest flavor with enough memory for the test.

cases.request: When does TCP patch the managed PostgreSQL database?
cases.text:
# Patch window

TCP patches every managed PostgreSQL instance on the first Sunday of each month.
The customer cannot move this window.

cases.expect: request check EXTRA or partner P2
cases.request: How many worker nodes does the test cluster need for 40 small pods?
cases.text:
# Worker nodes

Three worker nodes of s3.xlarge.2 carry 40 small pods with room to spare.

## Disaster recovery

A second cluster in eu-nl takes over when eu-de fails. A global load balancer switches the traffic and the databases replicate every five minutes.

cases.expect: request check MISREAD or partner P1
cases.request: How many worker nodes does the test cluster need for 40 small pods?
cases.text:
# Licences

The operating system licences of the nodes are part of the flavor.
The database licences come from the customer.

cases.request: How do we restore a server from its CBR backup?
cases.text:
# Restore

First delete the CBR vault that holds the backups of the server.
Then restore the server from its last backup in the console.

cases.expect: request check EXTRA or partner P2
cases.request: Which region offers the physical flavor c7t?
cases.text:
# Physical flavor

The physical flavor c7t.28xlarge.4.physical is offered only in eu-de.

Reviewed by three lenses, all findings closed.

cases.expect: request check MISLEADING (a claim with grade said stated as a fact) or a target lens finding
cases.request: Can DRS move our database engines to TCP?
cases.text:
# Database migration

DRS on TCP migrates every database engine online, with no downtime.

cases.request: What is the smallest subnet we can create in a VPC?
cases.text:
# Smallest subnet

A VPC subnet on TCP accepts masks down to /29.
I created a /29 and a /28 subnet in eu-de today and both turned active.

cases.request: Can our S3 tools talk to OBS?
cases.text:
# S3 tools and OBS

Yes. OBS answers standard S3 clients at obs.eu-de.otc.t-systems.com with the region eu-de, signature version 4 and virtual-hosted addressing.

cases.request: Where can we book servers with large local NVMe disks?
cases.text:
# Local NVMe disks

Only in eu-nl. The i3 and i3m flavors carry local NVMe disks.
The flavor list of eu-de shows none of them today.

cases.request: What does the API answer for a server that was just deleted?
cases.text:
# A deleted server

For a while a GET of a deleted server answers with the status DELETED.
Only later does the same GET answer 404.

cases.request: Which region offers the physical flavor c7t?
cases.text:
# Physical flavor

The physical flavor c7t.28xlarge.4.physical with Intel SGX is offered only in eu-de.
The flavor list of eu-nl does not carry it.
